messages:
jamie: Heads up — we need to lock a time for the Billing Export design review (API + SDK + Console). Aim: final contract + migration plan + UX edge cases. 60m preferred. Who's available later this week or early next? :clock3:

irene_pm: I can do Tue/Wed afternoon PT. Best window 2-4pm PT. I'll finalize the PR summary tonight and drop comments in the docs.

ajay_s: Wed around 3pm PT works for me (need infra coverage). OOO Thu morning.

sophia (console): I can do Tue 2pm or Wed 3pm. Will bring mockups, error states, and keyboard interactions.

max_devex: Wed 3pm PT is fine. I'll confirm SDK breaking-change checklist and any helper functions we need to add.

calendar-bot: Proposed slots posted: Tue 2026-06-16 14:00-15:00 PT, Wed 2026-06-17 15:00-16:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: for preferred slot.

jamie: Pre-reads (please annotate inline where you have blocking comments):
- API spec: https://rwd.infra/docs/billing-export/api-spec
- SDK migration guide: https://rwd.infra/docs/sdk/billing-export/migration
- Console designs: https://rwd.design/billing-export/mocks

jamie: Pre-read checklist (put an inline ✅ or comment next to items in the docs):
```
- Confirm request/response schema + examples
- Validate auth scope & service account usage
- Identify any non-backwards-compatible SDK changes
- Verify larger export performance/streaming behavior
- Review retry/idempotency semantics
- Mark any Console states that require feature flags
```

irene_pm: Quick ask: who will be the formal API contract approvers? Suggest @ajay_s, @maria_backend, @oliver_infra. I'll list them in the API doc approvers section.

jamie: Added approvers. Pinging Maria and Oliver now.

maria_backend: Skimmed API spec. Will add comments about pagination cursor format and idempotency-key header details. Can join Wed 3pm if that's the final time.

oliver_infra: Wed 3pm works. I'll prepare a one-slide summary on throughput, memory, and KV-cache implications for long-running exports.

sophia (console): Uploaded annotated mockups and a short video of the flow. Flagged one A11y issue for the export modal.

jamie: If Wed 3pm gets the most 👍, I'll send the calendar invite with recordings enabled and include the preread diff. Also: plan to record the session and capture action-items in a follow-up doc.

ajay_s: 👍 for Wed 3pm. Also note: infra will want a rollout plan with a hidden feature flag and canary config.

max_devex: 👍

sophia (console): 👍

maria_backend: 👍

jamie: Booking Wed 2026-06-17 15:00-16:00 PT. Draft agenda:
1) Goals + success metrics (5m)
2) API contract review & approvers (20m)
3) SDK migration checklist & timelines (15m)
4) Console UX walkthrough, error states, A11y (15m)
5) Rollout plan + action owners (5m)

jamie: Notes for pre-meeting prep:
- Please resolve/label any comments in the API doc as "blocking" or "nits" before Tue EOD.
- Add small reproducer snippets in the SDK guide for migration steps.
- Console: mark any flows that require backend changes with the API endpoint and expected response codes.

maria_backend: I'll mark the pagination comments as blocking and propose a contract that includes next_cursor + has_more.

oliver_infra: Uploading throughput slides and a short note about queueing/backpressure by Tue night.

jamie: Also: if anyone expects this to require >1hr, say now so we can extend or split into two sessions (contract vs UX).

ajay_s: We might need an extra 30m for SDK rollout if breaking changes are non-trivial. Tentative: hold follow-up slot Thurs morning if needed.

jamie: Good point. I'll tentatively block Thu 09:00-09:30 PT as a follow-up slot and mark it optional on the invite.

max_devex: Will draft migration-helper functions and post a small PR for review by Tue night.

jamie: Thanks all. I'll send the invite with preread links, checklist, recording enabled, and optional follow-up. Please get blocking comments in by Tue 6pm PT. :pray:
